personajes.en: Sun-darkened mestizo man, weathered face, thick gray mustache, white straw hat, denim shirt sleeves rolled, rubber boots, machete sheath at his belt, holding a small basket of red coffee cherries.

Brown-skinned mestiza woman, black hair in a low bun, bright floral blouse, jeans, white sneakers, layered plastic bead bracelets, carrying a woven plastic market bag full of fruits over one shoulder.
Lean tan-skinned man, short black hair, goatee, reflective safety vest over a hoodie, knee-padded jeans, athletic shoes, smartphone mount armband, helmet carried under one arm.
Afro-Colombian man, short curly hair, stubble beard, orange hi-vis vest over a plain gray t-shirt, work pants, steel-toe boots, yellow hard hat under his arm, trowel in gloved hand.
Light-brown-skinned young woman, long dark wavy hair, oversized hoodie, ripped jeans, white sneakers, canvas backpack with keychains, headphones around neck, holding a reusable coffee cup.
Fair mestiza elderly woman, silver hair in a neat bun, reading glasses on a beaded chain, knitted cardigan over a floral dress, low-heeled shoes, small black handbag, folded umbrella in hand.

Emberá indigenous woman, straight dark hair, traditional wrap skirt with geometric prints worn as daily dress, colorful handmade bead necklace on her chest, barefoot sandals, arranging her beadwork jewelry on display.
Afro-Colombian young woman, braided hair pulled back in a ponytail, light-blue medical scrubs with badge lanyard, soft clogs, stethoscope around neck, holding a small clipboard.
